From Zoya Hussain’s Shivani in Hunkkaar: The Roar to Chandan Roy Sanyal’s Bhopa Swami in Aashram, here are five characters whose next chapters we are looking forward to.

Adding to this, Zoya Hussain’s Shivani could have an important role to play in the next chapter of Hunkkaar: The Roar. The first season ends with Guruji, the influential spiritual leader, being sent to jail. Shivani, who is his daughter, is now positioned at an interesting point in the story.

Meanwhile, With her father behind bars, questions remain about what she will do next. Will she take responsibility for his empire and continue his legacy, or distance herself from his influence? Her decisions could introduce a new dimension to the show's exploration of power, influence and family dynamics.

Notably, Avinash Dwivedi’s Kuber Tripathi is among the characters audiences can look forward to revisiting in Dupahiya 2. Set in the fictional village of Dhadakpur, the series combines small-town humour with wedding-related complications and village politics.

As per the latest buzz, Kuber's interactions with the other residents contribute to the show's ensemble-driven storytelling. With the second season bringing the characters back, his relationships and involvement in the village's everyday chaos could offer more opportunities for humour.

Chandan Roy Sanyal’s Bhopa Swami has remained an important character in Aashram. As Baba Nirala's trusted aide, Bhopa is known for his loyalty, ambition and ability to navigate situations involving power and manipulation.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Making New Delhi the exclusive destination for this IP on the six-city India tour allows us to create something distinctive for audiences, combining international music, spectacular visuals and an atmosphere that promises to be unforgettable.”

Notably, Tickets for the New Delhi event are available through Thumpn across three categories. General Admission tickets start at Rs 3,000, while the Backstage Experience starts at Rs 12,000 and the Premium VIP Experience starts at Rs 30,000.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 8: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan film refuses to slow down, crosses ₹33 crore so far
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s Udta Teer has had a surprising ticket-window haul in the first few days of rollout. It opened to positive reviews and stood its ground despite the mammoth ticket-window pull of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2. But, that momentum has slowed down considerably as the movie entered its second week.

Adding to this, Ayushmann Khurrana plays a Pakistani spy in Udta Teer. Udta Teer ticket-window report Udta Teer surpassed expectations and collected ₹ 4.10 crore rupees on its opening day in theatres. It opened to decent reviews, which helped its cause and the movie gradually showed growth on Saturday to collect ₹ 7.25 crore rupees. Sunday showed more growth, at ₹ 8.20 crore rupees. It is the highest single-day haul of the movie so far. The dip started on Monday, as expected, but the movie stayed steady.

Meanwhile, As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Udta Teer has managed to collect ₹ 2.36 crore rupees on Wednesday. It is slightly above last day's haul which was at ₹ 2.25 crore rupees. This brings the total India collection to ₹ 33.26 crore rupees . The movie has to remain steady in the soon-to-release days, before the big rollout this Diwali in the form of Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana.

Notably, Taran Adarsh also pointed at the ticket-window performance of Udta Teer and wrote on X, “Udta Teer remains on par with Monday on Tuesday, with the discounted ticket offer boosting footfalls... The #BOGO ticket offer today [Wednesday] should help the numbers remain stable. The *Week 1* total is expected to be around ₹ 31 cr [+/-] – a fair result... The movie has one more week to make the most of its theatrical run, starting this Friday, before #Ramayana arrives next Thursday [5 Nov].”

As per the latest buzz, The movie follows a Pakistani spy, played by Ayushmann Khurrana, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.

In further updates, The movie also stars Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, late Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Sandeep Anand in supporting roles. The project marks the fourth collaboration between Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Guneet Monga-led Sikhya Entertainment after The Lunchbox, Kill and Gyaarah Gyaarah.

title: Exclusive| I will soon initiate the necessary criminal proceedings: Vidnyan Mane on Palash Mucchal case
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star-producer Vidnyan Mane , a childhood friend of India women’s cricket team captain Smriti Mandhana, says the Bombay High Court has dismissed a defamation case filed against him by music composer Palash Muchhal, Mandhana’s former fiancé. “This verdict conveys an important message: people should not file baseless and false cases in court merely to generate publicity,” Mane tells us, adding that he “now plans to initiate criminal proceedings against Muchhal”.

Adding to this, Palash Mucchal and Vidnyan Mane The legal dispute surfaced in January this year, weeks after Muchhal and Mandhana called off their wedding in December 2025. Mane had accused the composer of cheating him out of ₹ 40 lakh invested in his movie Nazaria. As per his complaint, the two met in Sangli in December 2023, and Mane transferred the money by March 2025. He alleged that the movie was never completed and his money was not returned. Mane also made personal allegations against Muchhal, who denied them and sent him a ₹ 10 crore rupees defamation notice.

Meanwhile, Claiming that the case was dismissed over procedural deficiencies, Mane says, “No one is above the law, and compliance with judicial procedures is mandatory for everyone.” Muchhal’s legal team did not respond for comments.

Notably, Mane adds, "I intend to bring before the public the various fabricated and imaginary stories that he has narrated so far, and expose how people are being misled. I also want the truth to become known to his family members, so that they too can understand the reality of his conduct and the alleged falsehoods, and see the truth behind his actions. Very soon, I will initiate the necessary and appropriate judicial as well as criminal proceedings in this matter, strictly through lawful channels."

title: Shraddha Kapoor proud to be part of Eetha, says what matters is a good film and she does not look at how many box office records are broken
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The trailer of Eetha is out and followers cannot have enough of Shraddha Kapoor 's transformation as the legendary dance artiste Vithabai Narayangaonkar, whose real-life story is no less than a cinematic spectacle. As per the latest update on news agency PTI, the star shared on the trailer launch event that she is always in search of good stories and that's why she sometimes does one movie in two years.

Adding to this, Shraddha Kapoor at the trailer launch of her movie Eetha in Mumbai on October 30, 2026. (Photo by Sujit JAISWAL / AFP) (AFP) What Shraddha shared With the movie, Shraddha Kapoor reunites with producer Dinesh Vijan after the mega success of horror-comedy films Stree and Stree 2. "I don't ever feel that I have broken any records or I've done something at the ticket-window. I haven't done anything. For me, it matters that it is a good movie. That's the reason sometimes I do one movie in two years," she shared.

Meanwhile, "I don't think (in terms of) women or men-oriented films. Our industry needs good stories and such stories should be made. I think it is a narrow thought (to divide films on the basis of gender). .. The success of a movie is incidental and not in anyone's hand. I'm just happy and proud to be part of Eetha," she added.

Notably, Eetha is a biographical drama directed by Laxman Utekar. The musical drama is rooted in Maharashtra's traditional tamasha and lavani dance forms and inspired by the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar. Eetha narrates the story of a woman who defied conventions and challenged the odds to chart an unforgettable place in history.

As per the latest buzz, Born on July 1, 1935, in Pandharpur, Maharashtra, Vithabai Narayangaonkar was introduced to the world of performance and tamasha from a very young age. People from several parts of the state flocked to watch her performances, which were a colourful amalgamation of music, dance and storytelling. For her artistry, she was bestowed with the prestigious President's award in the Tamasha genre. She also began to be known as "Tamasha Samradini" (Tamasha Empress) by her followers, and the government later instituted the annual Vithabai Narayangavkar Lifetime Achievement Award in her memory in 2006. Her figure became a symbol of dedication and bravery in Maharashtra. She died on January 15, 2002, at the age of 66 in Narayangaon, Maharashtra, following a paralytic attack.

In further updates, Produced by Dinesh Vijan and Laxman Utekar, the movie is presented by Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations with music by Ajay-Atul. The movie also features Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub and Siddharth Jadhav in pivotal roles. The music is composed by Ajay-Atul. Eetha is scheduled to rollout in cinemas on December 4, 2026.

title: Ashoke Pandit calls Naseeruddin Shah a "compulsive abuser" over "Dimagi Naxal" remark: “He should consult a psychiatrist”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shah had shared a video on Facebook in which he backed Jamia students protesting for the restoration of their student union. In the video, he was seen wearing a badge that read "Dimagi Naxal" and shared that he proudly identified with the label. He also questioned the Centre over its handling of student protests and referred to labels such as "anti-national" and "tukde tukde gang".
Adding to this, Reacting to Shah's comments, Pandit shared he was neither shocked nor surprised by the star's language, claiming that his conduct in recent months had become increasingly aggressive.

Meanwhile, "I'm not shocked, nor I'm surprised with Naseeruddin Shah's abusive language because, since last few months, in a year in fact, he's been constantly misbehaving, has become a compulsive abuser. The kind of language which he uses, the way he distorts his face, he exposes his frustration. There are reasons behind it, I can understand, and I pity him," shared Ashoke Pandit.
Notably, He further alleged that Shah's public appearances showed signs of frustration and claimed that the star's comments were affecting his public image.

As per the latest buzz, Pandit also attributed what he described as Shah's frustration to ideological differences over films that have performed well commercially. He specifically mentioned The Kashmir Files , The Kerala Story and Dhurandhar while making the claim.

In further updates, "Probably one of the reasons why he's feeling insecure is that the films which are doing well in the in the in the country is not suiting him. Films like Kashmir Files, Kerala Story, Dhurandhar. These narratives are not suiting them. They're suffering from an inferiority complex. Hence, this is kind of behaviour with which he's trying to come out. So I think, in the end, I would like to tell him that he should consult a psychiatrist because it's affecting his mental health. A normal person will not behave like this," shared Ashoke Pandit.

On top of that, Pandit's comments were made as reactions continued to emerge around Shah's video supporting the Jamia students. Shah has also of late spoken in support of students protesting at the Satyajit Ray Movie and Television Institute, making his latest statement part of a series of comments on student-related issues.

title: Mira Rajput tells Kareena Kapoor that embracing motherhood at the age of 21 had its challenges but Shahid Kapoor was extremely supportive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shahid Kapoor married Mira Rajput when she was 21 in 2015. In 2016, they became parents when Mira gave birth to a daughter named Misha. Mira has now opened up about embracing motherhood at such an young age as she appeared on the chat show, What Women Want, hosted by Kareena Kapoor .

Adding to this, What Women Want 6 saw host Kareena Kapoor in conversation with Mira Rajput. title: Shraddha Kapoor unveils EETHA trailer as she steps into the role of Lavani legend Eetha Bai; film to release on December 4
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Directed by Laxman Utekar, the musical drama explores the journey of an artist who overcame social conventions and personal challenges to leave behind a lasting legacy.

Adding to this, The trailer offers a glimpse into the world of Lavani, placing its music, performances and cultural traditions at the centre of the narrative. Through its visuals and musical sequences, the movie appears to explore not just the art form but also the experiences of the women who helped shape it. EETHA aims to bring the story of an artist and her journey to a wider audience through a big-screen musical drama.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the project, producer Dinesh Vijan shared, “One of the most exciting things about cinema is that every once in a while, you come across a story so extraordinary that you wonder why the world doesn’t already know about it. For me, EETHA was one of those stories.

Notably, When I first heard it, I was fascinated not just by the incredible world of Lavani — its music, its rhythm, its energy and its larger-than-life characters — but by the extraordinary women who brought this art form to life. We have celebrated their performances for generations, but how often have we stopped to understand their journeys? The courage, the sacrifices, the struggles and the sheer strength of these women are as extraordinary as the art itself. What amazed me was that a world so rich in culture, emotion and powerful human stories had remained largely unexplored in Hindi cinema. It felt like an incredible opportunity to bring this world and the people who shaped it to the big screen.

As per the latest buzz, We’ve given so much love to their art. Perhaps it’s time we gave just as much love to their stories. That’s what EETHA means to me. It’s more than a movie inspired by true events; it’s a celebration of an extraordinary art form and the remarkable women whose lives deserve to be seen, heard and remembered.”

In further updates, Shraddha Kapoor, who essays Eetha Bai, spoke about her experience of playing the central character and shared, “It’s a story about a woman whose art, courage and individuality make her unforgettable. The more Laxman sir told me about the character, the more I felt connected to her world. Playing this role has been an incredibly exciting experience, and I am thrilled for audiences to discover her journey on the big screen. This is also my grand reunion with Maddock Films after we made magic with Stree and Stree 2, which is thrilling to say the least. The entire team has put in so much hard work, and I cannot wait for audiences to experience the world of Eetha.”

On top of that, For director Laxman Utekar, the movie marks a departure in setting and subject from his previous rollout Chhaava . He shared, “After the smash hit success of Chhaava , which became a mega cinematic spectacle, I wanted to take audiences into a completely different world with EETHA . While the two films are vastly different in their settings, both are rooted in the extraordinary strength of their central characters. EETHA is the story of an artist who became a legacy. We have brought together authenticity, emotion and scale to create a cinematic experience that audiences can truly immerse themselves in.”

Producer Karishma Sharma of Kathputli Creations added, “India is home to extraordinary stories, rich cultural traditions and fascinating characters that deserve to be celebrated on the big screen. For us, the most exciting stories are those that are deeply rooted in our soil yet have the power to entertain and connect with audiences everywhere. EETHA brings together this very spirit. It is a remarkable story from our cultural heritage, told through music, drama, emotion and spectacle. We hope audiences discover a world that feels uniquely Indian, yet resonates universally.”

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC mutes replaces ‘UP’ with ‘village’ in Nakhrewaalii; 'Must be some East Delhi b***h' replaced with 'Must be some cheap little witch'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nakhrewalii was passed by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) earlier this week. Despite the adults-only rating, the Examining Committee of the CBFC asked for a few changes. The disclaimer in the beginning was modified. The word 'Maa ki' was muted and the word 'mother' was deleted from the subtitles.

Adding to this, In three places, the CBFC asked for dialogues to be replaced. Accordingly, the dialogue ‘UP mein sab poor hote hai kya Sumit’ was replaced with 'Tumhare yahan sab aise hote hai kya ...'. In another dialogue, 'UP' was replaced with 'village'. Lastly, the line 'Must be some East Delhi b***h' was replaced with 'Must be some cheap little witch'.

Meanwhile, Once these changes were made, Nakhrewaalii makers were handed over the censor certificate on October 28. The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 129.27 minutes. In other words, Nakhrewaalii is 2 hours, 9 minutes and 27 seconds.

Notably, Nakhrewaalii stars Ansh Duggal and Pragati Srivastava. It tells the story of a misogynistic young man whose love life takes an unexpected turn when the father of the girl he loves challenges him to secure a government job within a month. When he realizes that his only chance of landing the job is to become a woman, he decides to take the plunge. What follows is a series of hilarious situations, confusion and chaos.

title: Sharvari wears mother’s heirloom pink Patola saree for Yeh Prem Mol Liya promotions; says it feels like being ‘wrapped in her love and blessings’
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:
The star revisits a treasured family heirloom gifted by her mother after watching ‘Jhumka Patola’, giving the traditional saree a fresh interpretation.

Adding to this, The saree holds a special place in Sharvari’s family, having been worn by her mother over the years and associated with several cherished memories. According to the star, her mother gifted it to her after watching her song ‘Jhumka Patola’ for the first time. The gesture made the outfit particularly meaningful, turning it into more than just another look for a promotional appearance.

Meanwhile, Sharvari chose to give the traditional garment a fresh interpretation while retaining its sentimental value. The process also involved looking through old photographs of her mother wearing the saree, allowing the star to revisit the memories attached to it before presenting the reimagined look.

Notably, Sharing the story behind the outfit on Instagram, Sharvari wrote, “When my Aai watched #JhumkaPatola for the first time, I will never forget the love and pride in her eyes. She gave me her beautiful pink Patola saree as a blessing! An heirloom she has adorned over the years and made so many beautiful memories in. Reinventing something so precious to her and wearing it for promotions has been such a special feeling. Going through old pictures of her wearing it and then seeing her reaction to what we created was just priceless. Wearing her saree feels like being wrapped in her love and blessings!”

As per the latest buzz, The look reflects a personal approach to fashion, with Sharvari choosing to incorporate a family heirloom into her public appearances rather than opting for an entirely new ensemble. By reworking a garment connected to her mother’s memories, the star has also highlighted how traditional clothing can carry emotional significance across generations.

In further updates, Sharvari is currently promoting Yeh Prem Mol Liya , in which she stars opposite Ayushmann Khurrana. Directed by Sooraj Barjatya, the musical romantic family drama marks another Rajshri Productions venture centred on relationships and family values.
On top of that, Yeh Prem Mol Liya is scheduled to rollout in cinemas on November 27, 2026.

title: 'See you there': After CJP, AISA's Neha Bora extends support to INDIA bloc's Nov 1 anti-CEC protest at Ramlila Maidan
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Student activist and All India Students' Association (AISA) president Neha Bora extended her support to INDIA bloc's rally against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the alleged irregularities in the voter roll revision process. The protest is scheduled to be held at the Ramlila Maidan in Delhi on November 1.

Adding to this, AISA National President Neha Bora address the media during a press conference on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) issue at the Press Club of India, in New Delhi, India, on Thursday, October 29, 2026. (HT photo) "Our demand to seek Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, impose a complete halt on the SIR exercise, and withdraw the 2023 law will culminate in a movement at Ramlila Maidan on November 1," she shared in a video address, posted on her social media accounts.
Meanwhile, Bora urged the citizens to reach the Ramlila Maidan on November 1 to protect their voting rights and “uphold the sanctity of democracy”, as she shared, “See you there.”

Notably, The INDIA bloc has given the call for a "mega rally" on the issue of alleged "vote theft", seeking to press for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the special intensive revision (SIR) of the electoral roll. The rally on Sunday is expected to bring together opposition leaders, party workers, activists and citizens from across the country.

As per the latest buzz, Neha Bora's announcement came two days after the Cockroach Janta Party extended its support to the Opposition protest. “GYANU MUST GO! The Cockroach Janta Party extends its support to the INDIA Bloc’s November 1 rally. Nation above all,” CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke posted on X on Wednesday.

In further updates, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Thursday urged people to join the opposition bloc's November 1 'Chalo Dilli' march. He asked the people not to worry about police crackdown, claiming that the ruling BJP "will not have the guts to try any of their antics".

On top of that, The leader of opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha shared the opposition INDIA bloc's 'Chalo Dilli' march at Ramlila Maidan is to save democracy, put an end to "vote theft" and protect the Constitution. He urged student groups, regardless of their political affiliation, to join it.
During an 'Ask Me' session on Instagram, Gandhi shared the INDIA bloc march on November 1 would commence at noon from the Minto Road-Connaught Place junction and culminate at the Ramlila Maidan.

title: Mohit Malik on playing Birju Lohar in Mirzapur The Movie: “We cannot approach a character by simply deciding whether he is good or bad”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
As the crime drama arrives on Prime Video, the star discusses the challenge of portraying a flawed character whose choices do not always fit into clear moral categories.

Adding to this, The franchise has built its narrative around characters who frequently blur the lines between right and wrong. Birju Lohar fits into this morally complex world, with his flaws, questionable decisions and unpredictable nature shaping his character. For Mohit, the challenge was to understand Birju’s motivations without judging him through the lens of his own personal beliefs.

Meanwhile, Rather than categorising Birju as either good or bad, the star approached the role by examining the circumstances and emotions that influence his decisions. According to Mohit, portraying such characters requires an star to understand the reasoning behind their actions, even when those choices may be difficult to justify.

Notably, Speaking about playing Birju Lohar, Mohit Malik shared, “Birju is a flawed character who makes choices that may not always be right, and that is what makes him interesting to play. As actors, we cannot approach a character by simply deciding whether he is good or bad. We have to understand his mindset, his circumstances and what drives him to make certain decisions. Even when you don't agree with a character's actions, you have to find the reasoning behind them and make them believable. The challenge is to portray the character honestly without judging him. I believe audiences connect with characters who feel human, with their flaws, contradictions and complexities. With Birju, I wanted to understand the person behind his actions and bring that truth to the screen.”

As per the latest buzz, Mohit’s comments highlight an important aspect of his approach to the role: understanding a character beyond the choices he makes. By exploring Birju’s mindset and the circumstances surrounding his decisions, the star sought to present a layered portrayal while leaving audiences to form their own opinions.

In further updates, The digital rollout of Mirzapur: The Movie gives viewers another opportunity to explore the franchise’s familiar world of power struggles, rivalries and morally ambiguous characters. Mohit’s portrayal of Birju Lohar adds to that landscape, reflecting the complexity that has remained central to the crime drama’s storytelling.
On top of that, Mirzapur: The Movie is now streaming exclusively on Prime Video India.

title: Sara Ali Khan faces fatwa over Kedarnath Temple visit: Reports
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Reacting to the visit, the cleric shared that Islamic Sharia does not permit Muslims to participate in religious practices associated with another faith. “I want to make it clear that Islamic Sharia does not permit its followers to engage in shirk,” the cleric shared, as reported by Bhaskar English. He further added, “This means that no Muslim, whether a man or a woman, is allowed to adopt the religious practices of another faith or worship at a temple.”

Adding to this, The cleric as per reports described such acts as “impermissible and haram” under Sharia and shared Sara should repent before Allah. He also reiterated his position on the star's temple visit, saying, “I want to make it clear that such acts are not permissible.”

Meanwhile, As per the latest buzz, Sara travelled to Kedarnath by helicopter before joining devotees waiting for darshan. Pictures and videos from the visit showed her standing in the queue and later offering prayers at the temple.

Notably, Reports also shared that the star participated in the temple's puja and aarti and visited the Bhukunt Bhairav Temple. Her visit as per reports took place amid cold weather, with some reports stating that women devotees offered her a shawl to help her keep warm.

As per the latest buzz, Sara has maintained a connection with Kedarnath for several years. The shrine also has a link to her movie career, as she made her Bollywood debut with the 2018 movie Kedarnath , which starred the late Sushant Singh Rajput. She has returned to the temple on multiple occasions since then.

In further updates, The row has also brought attention to the Badrinath-Kedarnath Temple Committee's rules for non-Hindu visitors. As per the latest buzz, the committee requires non-Hindu devotees who wish to offer prayers at the shrine to submit an affidavit.
On top of that, BKTC CEO Sohan Singh Rangar as per reports verified to News18 that Sara's team had submitted the required affidavit before her visit.

A fatwa is generally understood as a religious opinion or ruling issued by an Islamic scholar on a question concerning Islamic law. In this case, the reported ruling reflects the position expressed by the cleric and should not be presented as a universal view shared by all Muslims or Islamic scholars.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

And now, Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learnt of a major development that could leave Shah Rukh Khan and Anirudh followers with mixed emotions. Anirudh, who has collected a massive following for his electrifying background scores, has amicably parted ways with King owing to his packed schedule. A source informed Bollywood Hungama, “Siddharth Anand and Shah Rukh Khan are determined to bring King to cinemas this Christmas without any delays. However, Anirudh has been juggling multiple commitments down South, making it difficult for him to devote the time and attention that a movie of this scale demands. After a cordial discussion, both parties mutually decided to part ways.” The source further opened up that the makers have now entrusted Sachin-Jigar with the responsibility of composing the movie’s music and background score.

Adding to this, "However, Anirudh has given the Theme Track of King to Shah Rukh Khan as a mark of his respect for the megastar, and Sachin-Jigar too will be reimagining the track for the entire background score of the movie. So King will still have the Anirudh touch with the theme track, but the entire score also the album, otherwise will be done by Sachin-Jigar," the source tells us.

Meanwhile, King is touted to be the most ambitious action movie of Hindi cinema, mounted on a mammoth budget as the makers are up to deliver a never-before spectacle. The estimated costs excluding SRK's fees and PnA is touted to be in the zone of Rs. 450 crore rupees, and every penny will be visible on the screen as per insiders.
Notably, "This is Siddharth Anand's biggest movie till date and a love letter to the legend of SRK. He has designed the full movie keeping his aura in mind."

title: Exclusive|Zoya Akhtar on Mumbai's floating advertising barges: We need respite not sponsored sunsets
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Zoya Akhtar, born and brought up in Mumbai, has always been vocal about developments in the city and concerns citizens face. Of late, the Maharashtra Maritime Board (MMB) invited tenders to introduce floating advertising barges and illuminated hoardings along Mumbai’s coastline, and Zoya opens up on her thoughts on it.

Adding to this, Zoya Akhtar “This city is bursting at the seams, with its population, construction, traffic, pollution, noise, garbage, lack of open spaces, felling of trees etc. It’s already an assault on the senses. We are in desperate need to connect with nature, and not disconnect further. And we need respite, not sponsored sunsets! Why would people want to look at ugly hoardings when sitting by the water,” she shares.

Meanwhile, Zoya adds that citizens should have a say before such installations are approved. “People pay through their noses for homes with a view and even if they don’t live by the sea, they spend a considerable amount to live in Mumbai. Their opinion has to matter.”

Notably, Concerns have also been raised about the impact of such advertising on Mumbai’s coastal environment and marine life. Separately, the growing presence of commercial signage raises another question: where should one draw the line between creative advertising and visual pollution? “Please mark certain areas for commercial advertising and limit it to that. A city must not have signage everywhere. It’s mentally taxing, we don’t realise but to be bombarded with constant messaging is very stressful for the mind,” Zoya ends.

title: Nakhrewaalii review: Aanand L Rai's rom-com is a familiar yet fun ride with enough laughs
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Are Aanand L Rai 's production Nakhrewaalii and Ayushmann Khurrana's Dream Girl 2 long-lost cousins? Well, both revolve around gender swapping, cross dressing, mistaken identities and romantic confusion. Are there then enough differences that allow Nakhrewaalii to carve out an identity of its own? Read on to find out.

Adding to this, Nakrewaalii stars Ansh Duggal and Pragati Srivastava. The premise The story revolves around Sumit Mishra (Ansh Duggal), a typical good for nothing guy who believes women have it easy, whether it is reservations or getting their way in almost every sphere of life. After his girlfriend back home gets married to someone else, he moves to Delhi to pursue higher studies. Here, he meets Paridhi (Pragati Srivastava), the daughter of his landlord. Sparks fly, there's intimacy, but his mindset immediately classifies Paridhi as a girl only good for 'fun' in his own words, while another girl who likes him at his college, and is a 'virgin', is fit for marriage. His life turns upside down as he realises his feelings for Paridhi, and has to bag a government job for her parents to agree to the union. How Sumit manages that forms the rest of the plot.

Meanwhile, The story is as old as time. But director Rahul Shanklya, along with writers Divy Nidhi Sharma, manage to keep things entertaining by peppering the first half with plenty of funny one-liners and amusing sequences.
Notably, The second half too manages to keep the laughter quotient intact, and that works in the movie's favour.

As per the latest buzz, However there are certain inconsistencies that are hard to overlook. For instance, our male protagonist transforms into a woman for a major part of the runtime, but the continuity in his appearance is messed up. One morning, he is seen sporting a clean shaven face, only for a rather noticeable two to three day old stubble to appear by the same evening. Heck, even in a wedding sequence where the scenes unfold back to back, the inconsistency is glaring. These may seem like minor details in the larger scheme of things, but they can be distracting, especially when the premise itself relies so heavily on it. One wonders why the makers didn't pay closer attention to something so basic.

In further updates, In the performance department, Ansh and Pragati both have a confident screen presence. Kumud Mishra plays a key role as a government official, and he's reliable, as usual. Gopal Datt as Paridhi's father is very funny with his one liners. Akash Makhija as Jhaadi's, Sumit's best friend makes you chuckle.
On top of that, The music by Vayu, Vaibhav Pani, Sharan Rawat, Gaurav Chatterji, Tanishk Bagchi is soothing and goes with the story.

Overall, Nakhrewaalii may share some DNA with Dream Girl 2, but it has enough of its own quirks and comic moments to stand independently. It isn't ambitious in its storytelling, and even tries to include a moral lesson. But with a likeable lead pair and funny moments, it largely serves its purpose.

title: Eetha trailer out: Shraddha Kapoor celebrates Maharashtra's Lavani legacy as she transforms into Vithabai Narayangaonkar in Laxman Utekar's musical
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shraddha Kapoor is stepping into the world of Lavani with her next movie, Eetha , in which she takes on the role of a celebrated performer who made her mark against all odds. Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have unveiled the trailer, offering a first glimpse of Shraddha in the role of Eetha Bai. Directed by Laxman Utekar, the musical drama draws inspiration from the life of Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar, the renowned Maharashtrian Lavani and Tamasha artist. Interestingly, this movie will mark one of the late Nana Patekar's last performances.

Adding to this, Eetha trailer out: Shraddha Kapoor's journey as a Lavani performer promises drama, dance and an inspiring story of survival. Trailer of Eetha The trailer offers a glimpse into the colourful world of dance forms such as Lavani and Tamasha, but there is more to Eetha Bai's story than music, dance and applause. It follows a woman navigating betrayal, heartbreak and the many obstacles that come her way as she tries to make a name for herself. A line from the trailer sums up her determination: “If I die without trying, I'll be remembered as helpless. But if I die dancing, I'll be remembered as a legend.”

Meanwhile, The movie also shines a light on the cultural roots of Lavani and Tamasha, as well as the women who have kept these traditions alive. Through Eetha Bai's journey, it celebrates an art form that has been an important part of Maharashtra's cultural identity. The trailer also features a lively exchange about the nauvari saree, with one character explaining why it is far more than just an outfit. It stands for the pride, identity and traditions of Marathi women.

Notably, On playing the titular role, Shraddha spoke about the opportunity to explore a character whose individuality and relationship with her art make her story worth telling. She shared, “It’s a story about a woman whose art, courage and individuality make her unforgettable. The more Laxman sir told me about the character, the more I felt connected to her world. Playing this role has been an incredibly exciting experience, and I am thrilled for audiences to discover her journey on the big screen. This is also my grand reunion with Maddock Films after we made magic with Stree and Stree 2, which is thrilling to say the least. The entire team has put in so much hard work, and I cannot wait for audiences to experience the world of Eetha.”

As per the latest buzz, Producer Dinesh Vijan shared the story stood out to him because it highlighted women whose contributions to an important cultural art form have not received enough recognition in mainstream Hindi cinema. He shared, “One of the most exciting things about cinema is that every once in a while, you come across a story so extraordinary that you wonder why the world doesn’t already know about it. For me, Eetha was one of those stories. When I first heard it, I was fascinated not just by the incredible world of Lavani — its music, its rhythm, its energy and its larger-than-life characters — but by the extraordinary women who brought this art form to life. We have celebrated their performances for generations, but how often have we stopped to understand their journeys?"

In further updates, He added, “The courage, the sacrifices, the struggles and the sheer strength of these women are as extraordinary as the art itself. What amazed me was that a world so rich in culture, emotion and powerful human stories had remained largely unexplored in Hindi cinema. It felt like an incredible opportunity to bring this world and the people who shaped it to the big screen. We’ve given so much love to their art. Perhaps it’s time we gave just as much love to their stories. That’s what Eetha means to me. It’s more than a movie inspired by true events; it’s a celebration of an extraordinary art form and the remarkable women whose lives deserve to be seen, heard and remembered.”

On top of that, Following the smash hit success of Chhaava, Laxman Utekar now returns with Eetha. Speaking about directing this musical story, he shared, “After the smash hit success of Chhaava, which became a mega cinematic spectacle, I wanted to take audiences into a completely different world with EETHA. While the two films are vastly different in their settings, both are rooted in the extraordinary strength of their central characters. EETHA is the story of an artist who became a legacy. We have brought together authenticity, emotion and scale to create a cinematic experience that audiences can truly immerse themselves in.”

Karishma Sharma, producer at Kathputli Creations, also spoke about the importance of taking stories rooted in India's cultural heritage to the big screen. She shared, “India is home to extraordinary stories, rich cultural traditions and fascinating characters that deserve to be celebrated on the big screen. For us, the most exciting stories are those that are deeply rooted in our soil yet have the power to entertain and connect with audiences everywhere. EETHA brings together this very spirit. It is a remarkable story from our cultural heritage, told through music, drama, emotion and spectacle. We hope audiences discover a world that feels uniquely Indian, yet resonates universally.”

title: HT Exclusive | Pankaj Tripathi and Aditi Rao Hydari’s Parivarik ManuRanjan to premiere on Sony LIV on November 13
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Pankaj Tripathi and Aditi Rao Hydari are set to share screen space for the first time in Sony LIV’s soon-to-release Hindi original movie, Parivarik ManuRanjan . Blending family drama, romance and humour, the movie is pitched as a festive entertainer. Hindustan Times has exclusively learnt when the movie will premiere on the streaming platform.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi and Aditi Rao Hydari bring family, romance and laughter together in Sony LIV’s Parivarik ManuRanjan. The rollout date announcement HT can confirm that Parivarik ManuRanjan, directed by Varun V Sharma, will premiere on Sony LIV on November 13, 2026, shortly after Diwali. The movie's teaser was rolled out last week, offering a glimpse of a light-hearted story about family relationships, bonds and the everyday situations that bring people together. With a mix of humour, romance and family drama, the makers are hoping to give audiences a movie they can enjoy with their loved ones.

Meanwhile, Pankaj says the movie's appeal lies in its everyday characters and the humour that comes naturally with family relationships. Sharing what he enjoyed about the project, the star says, “What I liked about the movie is its simplicity, relatable characters and the little moments of humour that make family stories so special. It has the warmth of family, a touch of romance and the kind of fun that makes for a perfect festive watch. I had a wonderful time being part of this movie and look forward to audiences enjoying this delightful ride with their loved ones.”

Notably, View this post on Instagram Aditi marks her first on-screen collaboration with Pankaj. Talking about her character and their experience working together, she adds, “It's a movie that wraps romance, humour and family drama into one heartfelt package, the kind you want to watch with the people you love. I had such a lovely time with my character, discovering her quirks and the little ways she connects with everyone around her. And sharing the screen with Pankaj ji for the first time was truly a joy. His humour is so effortless, so natural, that it made every scene feel lighter and far more fun.”

As per the latest buzz, Varun V Sharma has directed the movie, which he has also co-written with Brijendra Kala and Ali Abbas Zafar. Kala has also penned the dialogues. The movie is produced by Vinod Bhanushali, Kamlesh Bhanushali, Himanshu Kishan Mehta and Alicia Zafar, with Ali Abbas Zafar on board as creative producer.
In further updates, Pankaj was last seen reprising Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur: The Movie . He also featured in the comedy-drama Ohh My Dog, which premiered on Netflix in October 2026.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star-producer Priyanka Chopra Jonas has joined Indian short movie "We Were Here", directed by Pranav Bhasin, as an executive producer, lending her support to the project as it gears up for its Academy Awards campaign.

Adding to this, Priyanka Chopra Jonas joins Oscar-qualified Indian short movie 'We Were Here' as executive producer The Oscar-qualified movie, which has won more than 20 awards across the international festival circuit, has also brought on board star Andrew Scott and Tony Award-winning playwright and activist V as executive producers.
Meanwhile, Chopra Jonas shared she was drawn to the movie for its take on a subject that has become increasingly relevant.

Notably, "This movie offers a refreshing, witty take on a subject that feels very timely. I jumped at the opportunity to come on board as an Executive Producer to amplify this creative team and ensure their brilliant, original vision gets the spotlight it deserves," she shared in a note.

As per the latest buzz, "We Were Here" follows three retired men in a small Indian town who, convinced that machines are taking over human jobs, protest by pretending to be household appliances. Their unusual act of resistance takes an unexpected turn when one of their children joins an artificial intelligence company.
In further updates, Written and directed by Bhasin, the comedy explores themes of technology, employment and the fear of becoming obsolete through the lives of ordinary people.

On top of that, The movie has screened at more than 80 international festivals and won over 20 awards, including the Audience Award for Best Narrative Short and the Redbreast Unhidden Award at South by Southwest , as well as Best Live-Action Short Movie Under 15 Minutes and Best Comedy Short at Palm Springs International ShortFest.

title: Pyre review: Vinod Kapri's old-world tale of love and loneliness is heartbreaking
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Watching Pyre is like travelling back to an era gone by. Almost like watching something on Doordarshan in the 90s. There is a certain simplicity to life that the movie captures, one that seems to have gone missing somewhere along the way as we make up for it with Artificial Intelligence, quick-commerce apps, OTT platforms, social media…You get the drift.

Adding to this, Pyre stars 'newcomers' Padam Singh and Hira Devi, both of whom are over 75. The premise Directed by Vinod Kapri , who has also written and co-produced the movie, the story revolves around an elderly couple, Padam (Padam Singh Kapri) and Tulsi (Hira Devi), living in a remote mountain village in Uttarakhand. Interestingly, both actors make their acting debuts after turning 75, which deserves special mention.
Meanwhile, Life isn't easy for the couple. Basic medical and transport facilities are hard to come by, and they depend on fellow villagers to take them to the doctor for their ailments.

Notably, But then, as is often the case with small towns and villages, people are constantly looking to move to bigger cities in search of a better life. In the process, they leave behind their families, land and, in many ways, their culture. As more and more people migrate, Padam begins to worry about what will happen to them when they are eventually left all alone. Someone even suggests, jokingly, that they should die while the villagers are still around so that there would be enough people to perform their last rites. Padam, however, takes it seriously. Adding to his anxieties is a letter from their son, who left for the city in search of a better life 28 years ago and promised to return.

As per the latest buzz, For the most part, Pyre never feels like a feature movie. Over its two-hour runtime, it almost seems as if the camera is simply following this elderly couple around, observing them as they go about their lives and counting down their remaining days. There is an unhurried quality to the storytelling that might test some viewers' patience, but it also lends the movie its charm.

In further updates, The lead actors are natural, slipping into their characters with ease. Kapri touches upon several themes, including loneliness, companionship, migration, cultural identity and the price of progress, without making the narrative feel preachy. Some of the moments shared between the couple are genuinely moving because of how effortlessly they unfold.

On top of that, And if you are single, well, Pyre might just give you an existential crisis. Beyond the realities of ageing, the movie captures something universal: the human need for companionship. As life moves forward and the world around changes, having someone to share its little moments with becomes all the more important. That quiet yearning is what Pyre captures best. Cinematographer Manas Bhattacharyya's frames are beautiful.

There are pacing issues with Pyre, definitely. As the movie progresses, the director seems to get a little too comfortable with the narrative's rhythm. While the intention is to immerse us in the couple's everyday life, some sequences drag on longer than necessary. The movie could have benefited from a tighter edit, especially in the second half. At times, the storytelling feels repetitive.

title: Anil Kapoor reveals he shot Tezaab in Mannat before Shah Rukh Khan bought it, recalls SRK's days living in a flat

title: Paresh Rawal says he has done over 250 films but considers only 11 of them any good, reveals his favourite roles
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Paresh Rawal has been part of the movie industry for four decades. Over the years, he has appeared in films across genres, from action to comedy. Of late, Paresh, along with Aditya Rawal, Ananth Mahadevan, Sharib Hashmi and Tannishtha Chatterjee, attended the premiere of their movie Pastt Tense at the Jagran Movie Festival. During a conversation at the festival, Paresh opened up that he considers only 11 films from his extensive career to be good.

Adding to this, Paresh Rawal says he has only 11 good films in a career spanning over four decades. Paresh Rawal talks about his illustrious career During a Q&A session at the festival, Paresh was asked if he had ever counted the number of films in his filmography. The veteran star laughed and shared, “No. Jo acchi films hain, woh mujhe pata hain kitni hain (I only remember the good films).” When the host suggested that he might have acted in around 250 films, Paresh shared the number could be higher but that he considered only 11 of them good.

Meanwhile, His son, Aditya Rawal, also admitted to having counted the number of films that his father considers good. Paresh then recalled some of the films on his list, saying, "There was one role that I was very happy essaying. I put a lot of hard work into it and that was Sardar (1993). I got a chance to do a biopic. It was very close to my heart. Another role, which was also sort of a biopic, was Tamanna (1997). But that movie’s second half went haywire. It was based on a real-life character, Tiku. Then came Oye Lucky Lucky Oye (2008). It’s also close to my heart. In Mumbai Meri Jaan (2008), I got to essay a lovely character. The Storyteller (2025) mein bahut maza aaya, followed by Hera Pheri (2000), Dacait (1987), etc. I can’t list all 11, but I can assure you there are 11 such films.”

Notably, Paresh made his movie debut with Holi in 1984 and initially became known for playing negative roles. He gained recognition for his performances in films such as Naam (1986), Kabzaa (1988) and Sir (1993). He won the National Movie Award for Best Supporting Star for Sir and Woh Chokri. Over the years, he moved from serious and villainous roles to comedy, with his portrayal of Baburao Ganpatrao Apte in Hera Pheri (2000) becoming one of his most popular performances.

As per the latest buzz, He went on to feature in several comedy films, including Hungama, Garam Masala, Chup Chup Ke, Bhagam Bhag and Welcome. He also played notable roles in films such as Sardar, OMG – Oh My God! and Table No. 21. In 2014, he was awarded the Padma Shri.

title: Ramayana advance booking jumps 27% in US after positive reactions from premiere; Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses ₹15 crore in India
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

After a smashing start, the advance bookings for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana Part One had plateaued. But over the last few days, buoyed by the buzz from the movie’s Los Angeles premiere, the pre-sales have gained momentum once again, at least in the US. Back home, too, the advance bookings are starting to gain pace, with the movie still awaiting all language versions to open ticket bookings on a full scale.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi in a still from Ramayana. How Ramayana pre-sales are faring Advance bookings for Ramayana opened on Dussehra, 15 full days before its global rollout. By November 29, a week ahead of its scheduled rollout, the movie had grossed ₹ 15 crore rupees in advance bookings in India, selling 2.75 lakh tickets. Initially, the Hindi version was accounting for almost all of the pre-sales collections, but over the last week, more Kannada and Telugu shows have begun to open. The Hindi version still accounts for 83% of the movie’s advance bookings in India, but the Kannada and Telugu versions are making strides too. The Hindi version has now opened in over 1,600 screens. The Kannada version, which is now open in just over 100 screens, has crossed the ₹ 2 crore rupees mark, with some centres already reporting up to 80% occupancy for the morning shows. The Telugu shows have opened in only around 20 screens, but are still hurtling towards the ₹ 50 lakh mark. Tamil shows have opened in about a dozen screens over the last 48 hours, but have barely crossed the ₹ 4 lakh mark, selling fewer than 2K tickets.

Meanwhile, What has helped Ramayana’s case is the pre-sales buzz overseas. In North America, the movie will have paid previews on November 4, the eve of its rollout. According to Sacnilk, the movie went from $631K to $800K in tickets for those paid previews in just 24 hours after the Los Angeles premiere. This is a 27% jump in collections. In addition, Ramayana has grossed $500K for the rollout day from overseas territories. This brings the movie’s worldwide advance-booking gross to ₹ 25 crore rupees by the end of October 29, a week before its rollout.

Notably, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash ’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

As per the latest buzz, Sony Pictures will handle global distribution, excluding India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the movie in the Hindi-speaking market. The movie is also planned for a worldwide IMAX rollout.

title: Pankaj Tripathi says 'Mirzapur' shattered industry myth about star-driven films being BO pull
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Pankaj Tripathi says the success of "Mirzapur: The Movie" and "Hanuman Ansh" has challenged the notion that actors who are not known for delivering big openings cannot draw audiences to theatres.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi says 'Mirzapur' shattered industry myth about star-driven films being BO pull "Mirzapur: The Movie", a big-screen continuation of the popular series, rolled out in September to universal praise and minted ₹ 229.60 crore rupees nett at the India ticket-window.
Meanwhile, The movie followed three successful seasons of the show, which built a loyal audience for its characters.
Notably, It saw Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyenndu reprise their popular characters Kaleen Bhaiya, Guddu Pandit and Munna, respectively, along with other members of the original cast.

As per the latest buzz, "I feel of late two misconceptions have been shattered with regards to theatrical releases. One that a movie can be a smash hit in the third week of its rollout, as it happened in case of 'Hanuman Ansh'.

In further updates, "And another is that, even actors who don't typically get a big opening are capable of delivering one. So, these two instances have happened in the same month. The experts usually make some other narrative but the audience has shown that if they like something, they show all their love," Tripathi shared on day two of Jagran Movie Festival here.
On top of that, With "Mirzapur: The Movie", the star attributed the movie's success to the enduring popularity of its characters, who continue to draw audiences to cinemas.

"The audience has relatability with the characters of 'Mirzapur', they enjoy watching them and hence they went to theatres to watch the movie. People liked that world and the characters," he shared, adding that the duration of the movie will be a bit longer on OTT as compared to theatrical rollout.

title: Bhushan Kumar backs Rishab Shetty’s two-part film on Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, shoot begins early 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kannada star Rishab Shetty will take on the role of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in a two-part historical epic backed by Bhushan Kumar and filmmaker Sandeep Singh. Titled The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the movie will chronicle the Maratha king’s life, his achievements and his vision of Swarajya. The makers are expected to begin shooting in early 2027. Bhumi Pednekar, Arjun Rampal and Vivek Oberoi have also been linked to the project in earlier reports.

Adding to this, Rishab Shetty to play Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Bhushan Kumar and Sandeep Singh’s two-part historical epic. The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj collaboration The two-part saga will trace his journey through some of the most significant battles and victories, along with the sacrifices and lesser-known episodes that shaped his legacy. His sharp military mind, fearless leadership and determination to establish Swarajya will be central to the story. As a gesture to mark the association, Bhushan presented Rishab with a century-old painting of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the movie, producer Bhushan Kumar shared, “Maharashtra and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj have given us a legacy to be proud of, and I believe it is our responsibility to honour that legacy through cinema and share it with the world. When Sandeep Singh narrated The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, I felt a deep sense of responsibility to bring this extraordinary story to the big screen. With Rishab Shetty’s powerful screen presence and his ability to bring legendary figures to life, I believe we have the right combination to bring the courage, vision and spirit of Swarajya to audiences across generations. For T-Series, this is more than a movie; it is a tribute to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his timeless legacy.”

Notably, The makers are currently working on pre-production, with the movie expected to go on floors in early 2027. The two-part project will feature a large ensemble cast and a crew comprising Indian and international talent. The intention is to bring lesser-known aspects of Shivaji Maharaj's life to the forefront while celebrating the values and vision that continue to inspire generations.

As per the latest buzz, Presented by Gulshan Kumar and T-Series Films, the movie is a T-Series Films and Legend Studios production. Sandeep Singh will direct the project, with Bhushan Kumar and Krishan Kumar as producers. title: Parineeti Chopra ends Karwa Chauth fast at 35,000 feet, shares video from plane with Raghav Chadha: ‘You make all my dreams come true'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Several Bollywood celebrities celebrated Karwa Chauth on Thursday and shared glimpses of their celebrations on social media. Star Parineeti Chopra marked the festival in a special way this year, showing that distance and circumstances cannot come in the way of traditions. The star shared a video from a flight, giving followers a glimpse of how she celebrated the festival with her husband, politician Raghav Chadha , at 35,000 feet.

Adding to this, Parineeti Chopra and Raghav Chadha celebrate Karwa Chauth in a plane. Parineeti Chopra and Raghav Chadha celebrate Karwa Chauth in airplane Taking to Instagram on Thursday, Parineeti shared a video featuring herself and Raghav inside the plane. The couple were seen spotting the moon before Parineeti broke her fast mid-air. Raghav fed her water and food as she completed the ritual. Sharing the video, Parineeti wrote, “Karwa chauth is wherever we are. Even if its at 35000 feet! 🤗🥰” Praising her husband, she added, “You make all my dreams come true Ragaji. The best man, the best human, the best boii." The star was seen wearing a traditional suit and flaunting her sindoor as she celebrated the festival.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Parineeti Chopra (@parineetichopra)

Notably, The video reminded several followers of Priyanka Chopra's Karwa Chauth anecdote. During an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show in 2025, Priyanka opened up that her husband, Nick Jonas, had taken her on a plane above the clouds to help her break her Karwa Chauth fast when the moon was not visible. She shared, "We’ve tried to spot the moon in the strangest places. Once, we were at a stadium where he was doing a show, and the moon just wouldn’t appear. There were clouds, and rain was about to start. Around 60–70 thousand people were present and the show kept going on. We waited till 10 pm, then 11 pm, and still the moon wasn’t visible. Want to hear something romantic? He finally took me up in a plane, above the clouds, and then I broke my fast after seeing the moon."

While the familiar power games remain at the heart of the story, the movie takes the franchise into a new setting. The extended version on Prime Video also gives viewers a few more reasons to tune in. It features never-before-seen scenes that did not make it into the theatrical cut, offering additional footage from the world of Mirzapur. The movie was A-rated in cinemas and the runtime was 3 hours 17 minutes. Meanwhile, the runtime of the extended cut is 3 hours and 31 minutes on Prime Video.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Gurmmeet Singh on bringing Mirzapur to cinemas Director Gurmmeet Singh spoke about the excitement of bringing the movie to a much wider audience through its streaming premiere. He shared, “With Mirzapur: The Movie, the idea was to take a world that audiences know so well and explore how it could unfold on a larger canvas. As a director, it was exciting to approach these characters in a new way while staying true to the grit and intensity that define Mirzapur. The world of Mirzapur has always received immense love from audiences, and as the movie premieres on Prime Video, I’m excited for even more viewers to experience it. As a surprise for followers, the movie also features an extended cut with never-before-seen scenes, giving audiences more to discover in a world they have always loved.”

Notably, For Excel Entertainment producers Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar, the movie marked a new experience for a franchise that had built a loyal following through streaming. They also acknowledged the response to its theatrical rollout and hope its arrival on Prime Video brings more viewers into the Mirzapur universe.

As per the latest buzz, They shared in a note, “The love that audiences have shown Mirzapur over the years, and the connection they have with its characters, has been incredibly special to us. Taking the franchise to the big screen was a new experience for us, and we’re happy to see the movie receive so much love. As it now makes its way to OTT, we hope it reaches even more people and gives followers another chance to revisit the world of Mirzapur.”

In further updates, Devraj Sanyal, Managing Director of Universal Music India, opened up that this special cut was the one the makers had watched before the rollout. He wrote on Instagram, “ This extended cut is the version we watched before the movie’s official rollout. What reached cinemas was a shorter cut. And this one? Absolutely insane. This movie has been gratifying on so many levels. A ticket-window smash. The coming alive of one of India’s most successful stories of all time. Music that has been received spectacularly, with songs I believe we’ll be listening to for a very, very long time. And now, finally, you can watch it at home on Amazon Prime Video. Get together for a watch party. Watch it on your own, with people you love, with fellow followers, or with your community. Watch it any way you like. Just go right ahead, dive in and have fun. I promise you, this is one of the most incredible watches you’ll have in a long time. 🎬.”

On top of that, Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, the movie has been written by Puneet Krishna and directed by Gurmmeet Singh. Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar have produced it under the Excel Entertainment banner.

The cast features Ali Fazal , Pankaj Tripathi and Divyenndu , along with Jitendra Kumar, Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Mohit Malik, Sheeba Chaddha, Rajesh Tailang, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Harshita Gaur, Shweta Tripathi Sharma, Sonal Chauhan, Anangsha Biswas, Shaji Chaudhary, Satendra Soni, Kulbhushan Kharbanda and Sushant Singh.

title: Bhushan Kumar, Rishab Shetty collaborate on two-part Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj biopic
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Producer Bhushan Kumar has joined hands with star-filmmaker Rishab Shetty and filmmaker Sandeep Singh for "The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj", a two-part historical epic that is scheduled to begin production in early 2027.

Adding to this, Bhushan Kumar, Rishab Shetty collaborate on two-part Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj biopic Bhushan's banner T-Series has come on board as a producer for the project, which will be directed by Singh, with Shetty attached as co-producer, the studio shared in a note.
Meanwhile, The movie will chronicle the life and legacy of the Maratha ruler, focusing on his military campaigns, leadership and vision of Swarajya.

Notably, The announcement brings together Kumar, known for backing several successful Hindi movie productions through T-Series, and Shetty, who gained wider national recognition with the Kannada movie "Kantara" .
As per the latest buzz, As part of the announcement, Kumar presented Shetty with a century-old painting of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, marking the beginning of their collaboration.

In further updates, The two-part saga will explore key battles, victories, sacrifices and lesser-known episodes from the life of the 17th-century ruler. The makers are planning an ensemble cast and an international creative team for the project.

On top of that, "Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Maharashtra have given us a legacy to be proud of, and I believe it is our responsibility to honour that legacy through cinema and share it with the world," Kumar shared.

He added that Singh's narration of the story convinced him to take up the project, while Shetty's screen presence and ability to portray larger-than-life characters would bring the historical figure to the screen.

title: Anticipatory bail denied to three booked for allegedly misappropriating ₹4 crore from funds for Kartik Aaryan and Karan Johar's Naagzilla
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

A sessions court in Mumbai has denied anticipatory bail to three movie production executives accused of misappropriating more than ₹ 3.92 crore rupees during the making of the soon-to-release Dharma Productions movie Naagzilla .

Adding to this, Karan Johar and Kartik Aaryan are collaborating on Naagzilla. Court denies bail in Naagzilla fund misappropriation case On Wednesday, Additional Sessions Judge (Dindoshi court) M Mohiuddin also ruled that there was prima facie material against them about their involvement in the offence, news agency PTI reported. The court maintained that the custodial interrogation of the accused was necessary for a detailed investigation into the matter

Meanwhile, Naagzilla stars Kartik Aaryan and is co-produced by Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films. The three accused are consultant and signing authority Kuldeep Singh Champawat (47), service provider and executive producer Mahipal Karan Rathore (42), and line producer Shivkumar Tiwari (45). The PTI report shared that an FIR was lodged by Tukaram Mahadev Sawant, an accountant with Mahaveer Jain Films Pvt. Ltd, which is led by Mahaveer Jain and his wife, Neetu Jain.

Notably, Mahaveer Jain Films entered into an agreement with Dharma Productions Pvt. Ltd. to produce Naagzilla with a total budget of ₹ 82.50 crore rupees on October 30 last year. According to the complaint, Kuldeep Singh Champawat approached Mahaveer Jain to handle the movie's production and subsequently recommended his relative, Rathore, who was appointed as a service provider. Tiwari was hired as the line producer to onboard vendors for vehicles, makeup, and junior artistes.

As per the latest buzz, The prosecution has alleged that the three colluded to bypass the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and incurred unaccounted expenditure of ₹ 3,92,76,308 without submitting requisite bills or vouchers.

In further updates, The complaint also alleges that the accused inflated a vendor's bill from ₹ 85,000 to ₹ 1.30 lakh and paid ₹ 45,000 to a firm named ANM Global that rendered no services to the movie. In addition, they have also been accused of clearing over ₹ 1.50 lakh in fabricated bills prepared with a production assistant
On top of that, The investigating officer of the case informed the court that the accused extracted commissions and mobile handsets from vendors to award work and clear bills.

Naagzilla is directed by Mrighdeep Singh Lamba, written by Gautam Mehra and produced by Karan Johar, Mahaveer Jain, Adar Poonawalla, Apoorva Mehta, Mrighdeep Singh Lamba, and Neetu M Jain under Dharma Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films. It is co-produced by Marijke deSouza and Divyansh Jain. Kartik plays an icchadhari naag (shapeshifting snake) in the movie. The movie is set to rollout in theatres next year.

title: Ranbir Kapoor's distant cousin Siddharth P Malhotra says he will watch Ramayana for 'Lakshman' Ravie Dubey first
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana is one of the most anticipated films of the year. With the rollout date approaching (November 5), followers are eagerly waiting to watch the mythological epic on the big screen. While many are looking forward to seeing Ranbir Kapoor in the role of Lord Rama, filmmaker Siddharth P Malhotra, who is also Ranbir's distant cousin, has opened up that he is particularly excited to watch the movie for Ravie Dubey .

Adding to this, Siddharth P Malhotra reveals he's dying to watch Ramayana. Siddharth P Malhotra says he's dying to watch Ramayana In a conversation with NDTV, Siddharth shared he was 'dying' to watch Ramayana, but added that Ravie was his primary reason for looking forward to the movie. He shared, "I am dying to watch it. I love the look, but I love Ravi Dubey in it, because Ravi Dubey is someone I've launched, and Ravi Dubey is a brother to me, and I'm rooting for Ravi in the movie, who's playing Lakshman. And I'm excited, and I'm actually watching the movie for Ravi first before Ranbir... Because Ravi is a brother to me, a younger brother to me, and he's someone I really love as a human being. So my reason to watch Ramayana is, of course, Ramayana, but it's first for Ravie Dubey." Siddharth launched Ravie in the television industry with Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar.

Meanwhile, Siddharth is related to Ranbir Kapoor through the Kapoor family. His grandfather was veteran star Prem Nath, who was the brother of Krishna Malhotra, wife of Raj Kapoor. This makes Siddharth and Ranbir distant cousins. However, Siddharth shared he was closer to the older generation of the Kapoor family and knew Kareena and Ranbir mainly as cousins.

Notably, He also expressed his desire to work with Ranbir, saying, "It's a dream to work with Ranbir Kapoor. He's the best star in the country. But Ranbir Kapoor has the top of the top to choose from; why would he choose me unless I give him something that is beyond what the top of the top can give him? Why would he choose me? So I have to work hard to earn Ranbir Kapoor. He's not going to come easy. Or Alia Bhatt."

As per the latest buzz, Siddharth added that he considers Ranbir and Alia the best actors in the industry, stressing that their talent, rather than their movie-family backgrounds, is what sets them apart. He also shared that everyone wants to work with them, making it extremely difficult for filmmakers to get an opportunity to collaborate with the two actors.

In further updates, Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. title: Rakul Preet Singh says Surpanakha is a very misunderstood character, calls Ramayana India's representation to the world
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ramayana is the biggest rollout of the year. After the first trailer that was unveiled by the makers, it went widely shared over the looks of Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama to Sai Pallavi as Sita. Many on the internet debated on the look of the characters as well as the scale of the epic adaptation. But if there was one highlight from the trailer that took everyone by surprise, it was Rakul Preet Singh 's glimpse as Surpanakha.

Adding to this, Rakul Preet Singh's Surpanakha was one of the few highlights of the Ramayana trailer. What Rakul shared Now, in an interaction with news agency PTI, Rakul has shared her excitement on taking up the role of Surpanakha and shared, “I think what was so exciting were a couple of things. First, it's India's representation to the world. Our history, our truth represented to the world's first ever-global movie. Secondly, Surpanakha is a very misunderstood and layered character. She was the reason why the war took place in the first place. So it has been really interesting to play someone with multiple shades.”

Meanwhile, Earlier, the star had reposted a fan letter on her X account with a note. It read, "Thank you for this beautiful letter. What made me say yes to Surpanakha was exactly what you mentioned - her complexity. History often remembers her for one moment, but there is so much more to her story. As an star, roles that challenge perception are the most exciting. I hope audiences discover her with an open mind when Ramayana arrives. (folded hands emoticon)"

Notably, As per Hindu mythology, Suparnakha was the root cause behind the battle between Ravana and Rama. In order to avenge the insult of Surpanakha, Ravana disguised himself as a sage and kidnapped Sita, which ultimately led to the war.

As per the latest buzz, Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu (played by Ranbir Kapoor), and his battle against the asura king Ravana (played by Yash) after the latter abducts his wife, Sita (played by Sai Pallavi). The epic is one of the most familiar stories in the Indian subcontinent and is revered by Hindus as a sacred text.

In further updates, As per reports mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees"> ₹ 4,000 crore rupees , the movie is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.
